landing.faq.stack.question: What's the tech stack?
landing.faq.stack.answer: Next.js 16 with the App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, Drizzle ORM, and better-auth. Every piece of business logic is inlined — no external packages for payment, email, storage, or AI.
landing.faq.payment.question: Which payment providers are supported?
landing.faq.payment.answer: Stripe, PayPal, Creem, Alipay, and WeChat Pay out of the box. The PaymentManager abstraction makes it straightforward to add more providers by implementing a single interface.
landing.faq.database.question: Which databases can I use?
landing.faq.database.answer: Drizzle ORM handles PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Turso, and Cloudflare D1. Switch providers by editing DATABASE_PROVIDER in your .env — the schema templates and drizzle config adapt automatically.
landing.faq.customize.question: How customizable is the landing page?
landing.faq.customize.answer: The src/blocks/ directory ships with demo sections — they're designed to be rewritten per project. The durable primitives live in src/components/, so your rebrand touches blocks and translations, not the chassis.
landing.faq.license.question: Can I use this for commercial projects?
landing.faq.license.answer: Yes. ShipAny Next is built for shipping production SaaS products. You own the code after cloning — no per-seat fees, no runtime dependencies on our infrastructure.

landing.faq.public_private.question: Can I export a private or unlisted playlist?
landing.faq.public_private.answer: Public playlists work without signing in. Private playlists are not accessible, and unlisted playlists work only when YouTube makes their metadata available through the API.
landing.faq.limit.question: How many videos can I export?
landing.faq.limit.answer: The free launch version exports up to 500 videos from one playlist. Larger playlists include the first 500 available videos.
landing.faq.retention.question: Do you store my playlist or export?
landing.faq.retention.answer: No exported spreadsheet or playlist history is stored. The service requests public metadata, then your browser generates the download.
landing.faq.formats.question: Which export formats are supported?
landing.faq.formats.answer: You can download CSV, Excel, Text, Bookmark HTML, JSON, Markdown, XML, HTML, YAML, SQLite, Word, M3U and M3U8. One selected format downloads directly; multiple formats—or no selection—download as one ZIP.
landing.faq.quota.question: What happens if the YouTube API quota is reached?
landing.faq.quota.answer: You will see a clear status instead of a broken file. Try again later after the API quota resets.

tools.link.faq_1.answer: No. It extracts public metadata and canonical YouTube watch links only.

tools.link.faq_2.answer: Yes. Available videos are listed in the same order returned for the playlist.
tools.link.faq_3.question: Can it extract private or deleted videos?
tools.link.faq_3.answer: No. Private, deleted, and otherwise unavailable items do not expose a usable public link through the API.
